text: I'm answering the open questions for the Missions run now. Then I'll collect the other runs.
Still waiting on the NACA page run. I'll check it again.

I ran Trusted Tester checks on all five pages. These are agent-assisted results, not a certified Trusted Tester result. Several criteria stay NEEDS_REVIEW because the tool could not settle them. I mapped the tool's tests to WCAG 2.0 criteria and did not apply WCAG 2.1 or 2.2.

**Findings that apply to every page**
- **2.4.1 Bypass Blocks:** FAIL on careers, missions, Artemis III and ksc-history. The page starts with the shared header, which begins with the "Explore", "News & Events" and "Multimedia" buttons. None of them moved keyboard focus past the repeated content, and there is no skip link. On the NACA page the tool tried only 8 possible skip mechanisms, so I left it as NEEDS_REVIEW.
- **3.3.2 Labels or Instructions:** FAIL on all five pages. The header "Search" box (the second Tab stop) has only placeholder text as its label. On missions the "SEARCH CONTENT" box has a visible label, but the header search does not.
- **2.4.5 Multiple Ways:** NEEDS_REVIEW on all five pages. The only way the tool found was site search, and it found no way to reach missions or the NACA page. The sitemap and home page were not checked, and the ksc-history run was still going when I stopped.
- **2.2.2 Pause, Stop, Hide:** NEEDS_REVIEW on all five pages. The tool saw long timers (about 30 to 150 s) or server polling that it could not watch long enough to judge. On the NACA page, content moves by itself and I could not confirm a stop control. I called the pulsing scroll indicators not essential, but I did not look at the first moving item, a large area at the top of the page, so that one is unsettled. That is why 2.2.2 is NEEDS_REVIEW rather than FAIL there.

**Per page**
- **careers:**
  - 1.3.1 and 4.1.2 are NEEDS_REVIEW because the tool could not read the text around six text boxes.
  - 2.4.7 is NEEDS_REVIEW because the tool could not decide whether three links show focus. 2.4.3 is NEEDS_REVIEW because the focus order departs from the reading order and I could not judge it.
- **missions:**
  - 2.4.3 and 2.4.7 are NEEDS_REVIEW for the same reasons. 2.4.7 covers about a dozen items the tool could not see clearly.
  - 1.3.1 and 4.1.2 are NEEDS_REVIEW. The tool flagged the checkbox groups as not tied to their headings, such as "MISSION STATUS". That grouping is outside the narrow label-association scope you set.
  - 2.4.6 is NEEDS_REVIEW because only the first 60 of 101 fields were checked. 3.2.2 is NEEDS_REVIEW because the tool checks at most 40 fields per call and the full run needs your approval to run without a time limit.
  - 3.3.1, 3.3.3 and 3.3.4 are NEEDS_REVIEW because the form's server response can't be seen from the saved copy of the page.
- **Artemis III:**
  - 2.4.7 is FAIL: the "Hide player controls" button shows no focus indicator.
  - 2.1.1 is NEEDS_REVIEW because the page has an embedded frame the tool could not read. 1.3.1, 2.4.6 and 4.1.2 are NEEDS_REVIEW for the same reason.
  - 2.4.3 is NEEDS_REVIEW because the video player's focus order jumps and Shift+Tab differs from the reverse of Tab.
- **NACA:**
  - 2.4.7 is NEEDS_REVIEW. The tool reported FAIL, but the detail it gave was mostly "never in view" items. I could not confirm which element actually fails.
  - 2.1.1, 1.3.1, 2.4.6 and 4.1.2 are NEEDS_REVIEW because of the embedded video frames.
- **ksc-history:**
  - 2.4.7 is NEEDS_REVIEW because the tool could not compare before-and-after images for about 40 gallery links.
  - 2.4.3 is NEEDS_REVIEW because the gallery's focus order jumps and I could not judge it.
  - 1.3.1 and 4.1.2 are PASS.
  - 2.4.6 is DNA because no field has a visible label.

Across the other criteria, 1.4.2 is DNA everywhere because no audio played. The rest are PASS or DNA as shown below: keyboard, no keyboard trap, on focus, on input, and the consistent navigation and identification criteria.
